name: Análisis de Formantes de Audio
description: Analiza formantes de audio para detectar manipulación vocal en videos
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Audio Formant Analysis
mechanism:
This method analyzes speech formant structure for audio deepfake detection following Chetty & Wagner (2006):

1. **Formante Extracción**: Speech segments are analyzed using Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) to extract formant frequencies F1-F4 and their bandwidths. Formants are the resonant frequencies of the vocal tract, determined by physical anatomy — tongue position, jaw opening, and vocal tract length.

2. **Formante Trajectory Análisis**: Temporal trajectories of formant frequencies are tracked across phoneme transitions. Natural speech shows smooth, physiologically constrained formant transitions governed by articulatory dynamics. AI-generated speech may exhibit unnaturally abrupt formant shifts or overly smooth trajectories lacking natural micro-variations.

3. **Speaker - Specific Formante Modelado**: Each speaker has characteristic formant ranges determined by vocal tract geometry. The method builds a speaker-specific formant model and checks consistency — deepfake audio may inadvertently blend formant characteristics from source and target speakers, creating acoustically impossible vocal tract configurations.

4. **Formante Bandwidth Análisis**: Natural formant bandwidths reflect the damping properties of the vocal tract. AI synthesis often produces formants with unnatural bandwidth patterns — either too narrow (over-resonant) or too uniform across frequency bands, lacking the frequency-dependent damping of real vocal tracts.

5. **Harmonic - to - Formante Ratio**: The relationship between harmonic series and formant peaks is analyzed. In natural speech, harmonics interact with formant resonances in predictable ways governed by source-filter theory. Synthetic speech may show anomalous harmonic-formant relationships indicating generated rather than physical sound production.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
